title: Bound sales returns by explicit approved shipment capacity
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: An existing authorized sales return operator linking SourceStockOutId must resolve an approved live shipment belonging to the same customer and authoritative source warehouse/product/base-unit evidence at create/update/submit/approve. Enforce current customer data scope and existing menu; reject unknown/deleted/cancelled/foreign source and conflicting source snapshots without number consumption or mutation. Null genuinely unlinked legacy returns remain explicit under existing legitimate permissions, never guess links from numbers.

At approval serialize source shipment and return lifecycle in one transaction; total effective approved returns across all linked documents, including duplicate product lines converted under existing base-unit rules, cannot exceed approved shipped product quantities. Fail closed on inconsistent units or corrupt negative quantity evidence, never silently clamp. Atomic inventory/cost/ledger/status posting and explicit unaudit release only; preserve original quantities, financial records and movement audit. Verify two-connection concurrent returns, later-line rollback, exact boundary, over-return, source edit and permission revocation with real business code, not a duplicated test implementation.
